claims.summary: After nominative-form два/две, три, and четыре, the noun appears in genitive singular; accusative inanimate uses the nominative form of the numeral.
The source documents gender selection два/две and examples два стакана, две книги, три книги.
Cornell directly attests the numeral phrases два стакана, две книги, and три книги.
The rule is restricted to the nominative-form numerals; other declined numeral forms have other case patterns, and numerals five and above use genitive plural.
